notes: PRINTING United Expo 2026 will be held September 23-25, 2026 at the Las Vegas Convention Center. The event typically attracts 800+ exhibitors and 25,000-30,000 attendees. Based on consistent participation patterns from 2022-2025, the companies listed represent confirmed exhibitors from recent years and sponsors who are highly likely to return in 2026. The expo is the largest printing and graphics event in North America, with strong representation from wide-format printer manufacturers, vinyl film suppliers, finishing equipment providers, and graphics materials distributors - all highly relevant to DuPont Tedlar's protective film applications in signage, vehicle wraps, and architectural graphics. Booth selection for 2026 opened October 22, 2025, with many returning exhibitors already securing space.
